dialect: GoogleSQL default grammar (ParserOptions with default LanguageOptions; no catalog, no analyzer, no macro expansion)
parser_family: GoogleSQL (formerly ZetaSQL) parser: Textmapper-generated LALR parser (googlesql.tm) with its own tokenizer, lookahead transformer and generated ASTNode classes; independent of the PostgreSQL, SQLite, DuckDB, libgda and tree-sitter-sql grammars
oracle: The replay parses every statement with ParseNextStatement and walks the returned AST (ASTSelect select_list, where_clause and group_by grouping_items; ASTOrderBy ordering_expressions; ASTJoin nodes; ASTTablePathExpression and ASTInsertStatement target paths; ASTInsertStatement column_list and ASTInsertValuesRowList rows; ASTFunctionCall names; ASTStringLiteral string_value; ASTIntLiteral and ASTFloatLiteral images) and prints the summary; run-control requires the hand-written oracle summary.
api: googlesql::ParseNextStatement(ParseResumeLocation over local SQL text, ParserOptions{LanguageOptions()}, &ParserOutput, &at_end_of_input) -> ParserOutput::statement() (ASTStatement tree)
coverage: LLVM source coverage of the pinned GoogleSQL 2026.11.2 googlesql/parser sources reached by ParseNextStatement: the hand-written tokenizer, lookahead transformer, parser driver and AST code plus the Bazel-generated Textmapper lexer and parser (tm_lexer.cc, tm_parser.cc) and AST headers, mapped under one prefix; abseil, protobuf, ICU and the rest of GoogleSQL are built without coverage
scope: SQL statements from local bytes parsed by googlesql::ParseNextStatement with default LanguageOptions and no catalog; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. Name resolution, the analyzer (resolved AST), the reference evaluator and dialect-specific syntax are untested.
